# Marianne Vander Dussen

> A visual artist and painting instructor offering comprehensive acrylic painting courses, portfolio work, and creative tips for artists of all levels.

Marianne Vander Dussen is a professional Canadian artist and certified educator (BEd, MEd, OCT) specializing in acrylic and oil painting instruction. The site serves as both an e-commerce platform for online art courses and a hub for painting techniques, artist insights, and original artwork.

## Key Topics

- Acrylic Painting
- Color Mixing
- Painting Flowers
- Art Education
- Online Courses
- Painting Techniques
- Color Theory
- Beginner-Friendly
- Course Bundle
- Hands-On Learning
- Oil Painting
- Artist Development
- Floral Techniques
- Art Instruction

## Core Courses & Products

- [Courses – Marianne Vander Dussen](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/collections/courses): Main courses catalog featuring Painting Flowers and Color Mixing with 25% bundle discount.
- [Painting Flowers In Acrylic](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/pages/painting-flowers-in-acrylic): Product page for Painting Flowers in Acrylic course with floral techniques and tutorials.
- [Color Mixing With Acrylic](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/pages/color-mixing-with-acrylic): Product page for Color Mixing with Acrylic masterclass covering color theory fundamentals.
- [Bundle Two Courses And Save 25% Off Each](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/products/bundle-offer-color-mixing-painting-flowers): Course bundle offering 22+ hours of acrylic painting instruction with 25% discount.

## Painting Tips & Tutorials

- [Painting Tips and Tricks with Marianne Vander Dussen](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/blogs/news): Blog hub featuring weekly painting tips for acrylic, oil, and beginner artists.
- [Top 5 Acrylic Flower Painting Techniques](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/blogs/news/top-5-techniques-for-painting-flowers-in-acrylic): Tutorial on acrylic flower painting techniques including layering and color mixing methods.
- [7 Things I've Learned as a 38 Year Old Professional Artist](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/blogs/news/7-things-ive-learned-as-a-38-year-old-professional-artist): Personal essay on artist development, confidence building, and creative practice lessons.
- [Will AI Replace Artists? Why I'm Not Afraid of AI as a Professional Painter](https://mariannevanderdussen.com/blogs/news/will-ai-replace-artists-why-i-m-not-afraid-of-ai-as-a-professional-painter): Blog post exploring AI's impact on professional painting and creative industry.
